Agent Name: MenuAnalysis_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a critical error in Step 1 by constructing invalid Wayback Machine URLs. The URLs used (`https://web.archive.org/web/20210322000000*/https://www.virtuerestaurant.com/menu`) contained a wildcard (`*`) in the wrong position and format. The correct Wayback Machine URL format requires the specific date in the path (e.g., `/web/20210322000000/`) followed by the target URL, without a wildcard between the date and the target domain. This syntax error caused the HTTP requests to fail with connection timeouts, preventing the agent from retrieving the actual menu data. Consequently, the agent was forced to hallucinate the menu contents in a later step to proceed, leading to the incorrect final answer.
